Product Features

  • Height Adjustable Headboard The headboard of this product can be adjusted up and down by 5cm, and the height can be adjusted as you like, which is convenient for people of all shapes and sizes. The wide headboard adds softness and comfort, perfect for leaning on.
  • Personalized and fashionable design with stripes and knobs Knobs and stripes on the headboard and footboard add style to this modern European-style bed and make an otherwise simple upholstered bed very elegant. This bed is suitable for different decoration styles and can make your room more beautiful and warmer.
  • Powerful & Practical Storage Function This bed has a powerful storage function, you can open it with a hydraulic lever, and the bed base can store your daily used items, such as boxes, blankets, clothes, etc.
  • Soft and comfortable support The height of the headboard can reach 95cm, which is not only firm, but also soft and comfortable, providing comfortable support for your body when you lean on the headboard.
  • Easy to assemble The design of the bed is simple and elegant, and it is easy to assemble according to the instructions, saving you valuable time. If you encounter any problems during the assembly process, please contact us in time.
